title: Vietnam signs the Artemis Accords
excerpt: The agreement was signed on October 28, 2026, during Vietnam International Digital Week.
bodyHtml:
The United States Department of State announced that Vietnam has joined the Artemis Accords. The Accords, established by the United States and seven other countries in 2020 during President Trump’s first term, serve as a set of practical principles to guide responsible space exploration.

Vietnam is the 78th nation to sign the agreement. Minister of Science and Technology Vũ Hải Quân signed the Accords on behalf of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam on October 28, 2026. United States Ambassador to Vietnam Jennifer Wicks witnessed the signing at a ceremony on the margins of Vietnam International Digital Week in Ha Long, Vietnam.

According to the United States Department of State, the signing extends the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership into a new frontier. The Department of State and NASA lead the United States’ outreach and implementation of the Accords.
